questionSnapshot.question: What animation company did Walt Disney incorporate in Kansas City in spring 1922?

notes: Full Walt-category context and Laugh-O-gram search read. q130 asks the fairy-tale short series, not company incorporation. q682/q1177 concern Hollywood founding; q959 concerns Burbank.

verification.context: Specific corporate incorporation in Kansas City in spring 1922; no first-studio superlative.

premise.reason: Both museum and studio-preservation organization place Laugh-O-gram incorporation in spring/May 1922.

sources.locator: Paragraph contrasting Newman shorts and Kaycee Studios in 1921 with spring 1922 incorporation
sources.evidence: Walt incorporated Laugh-O-gram Films in spring 1922; 1921 refers to earlier work and the Kaycee venture.
sources.limitations: Institutional or original-studio preservation organization text inspected. No film playback claimed; exact calendar day is not asserted.
